entries.complaint: Water and detergent sit in the door gasket folds after every load, growing mold and a musty smell that gets into clean clothes
entries.redesign: A gasket with no folds that slopes to drain holes, plus a short fan-dry run after each cycle that blows out the drum and gasket, so no one has to wipe it down or leave the door open
entries.prior_art: LG's redesigned gasket with drain holes; machines with drum-dry or auto-vent features

entries.complaint: Lint gets past the filter and builds up behind the drum or in the vent, where owners can't see or reach it, until it starts a fire
entries.redesign: A sealed lint path with no gaps around the filter, an airflow sensor that warns on the display when the vent is restricted, and a front panel that comes off without tools to reach the area behind the drum

entries.complaint: Faint or confusing fill lines inside the cap lead people to use too much detergent, which wastes money and leaves residue on clothes and in the machine
entries.redesign: High-contrast dose lines molded on the outside of the cap with load-size words, and a full cap equal to one normal dose so 'fill it up' is correct

entries.complaint: The end-of-cycle chime is very loud by default, is silenced with hidden button combinations that differ by model, and some beeps can't be turned off at all
entries.redesign: A labeled volume control on the panel (off, low, high) that also mutes button beeps, with quiet hours that switch the chime to a light or phone notification overnight

entries.complaint: Fitted sheets and duvet covers wad into a damp ball that swallows socks and small items and comes out wet in the middle
entries.redesign: A bedding cycle that reverses the drum direction to keep the load from wadding up, and fitted sheets with corner snaps that clip together before washing

entries.complaint: More than three dozen care symbols that most people can't read, so clothes get shrunk or ruined in the wash
entries.redesign: Plain-words care instructions printed on the inside seam (for example, 'Wash cold · Hang dry · No bleach') next to the symbols, with no scratchy sewn-in tag
